input.question: What is the population of Madi Municipality?

documents.text: Nepal Government records as of 2017 , there were total 8,899 in Madi Municipality with 4,356 ( 48.95 % ) of males and 4,543 ( 51.05 % ) females . There were total 55 schools . In average , 162 students were studying in each school . View Full Chart The pie-chart and graphs above further illustrates the students and schools . Population by Language Spoken Mostly spoken language in Madi is Nepali , which is spoken by 22,795 people .
